items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE for Cardinals. Risk/reward RB2; wouldn't activate if worried about ankle. Starting him everywhere but some risk as it's the Cardinals.
items.implication: Viable RB2/flex with upside if role solid
items.opportunity: Rookie touches vs LAC, committee risk with Allgeier

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially is active today (calf).
items.implication: Full go or near in CHI offense with Burden/Swift
items.opportunity: WR targets with DJ Moore gone

items.text: Main slate news locked. Malik Nabers (Q, knee) murky for SNF, up to him. Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and Dalen Cambre. Projections updating; only major potential change.
items.why: Full practice but decision his; elevations signal caution
items.implication: Hold/start if active; fade if out for Fields/Mooney
items.opportunity: If out: targets to other Giants WRs; if in: high upside

items.text: Kamara not expected to play (knee); status affects projections of Travis Etienne and others. Weekend summary flags him NOT EXPECTED.
items.opportunity: Etienne unchallenged lead back, passing downs

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4 to 6 weeks.
items.implication: Long absence; NE WR depth elevated

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs remains on Commissioner Exempt list; NFL could count time as served for potential suspension (min 6 games DV possible). Sources expect this case.
After meniscus trim Tuesday, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at Chargers. OUT for Week 1.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team optimistic short absence
items.implication: Michael Mayer elevated TE role Week 1; stash Bowers

items.text: Cooper Rush will be Atlanta’s starting QB today; Tua and Penix inactive. Zaccheaus emergency QB and 3rd RB with only two RBs active (Bijan, Brian Robinson).
items.implication: Downgrade ATL pass game slightly; Bijan/London still strong

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive today (back, contract issues; trade possible).
Not expecting any major changes to projections other than Malik Nabers (Q, knee) news. Projections live for every player.
items.implication: Trust current ETR projs except Nabers contingency

items.text: Chuba Hubbard flex play this week but viable; keeping it open on The Chubbler.
items.why: Viable flex amid CAR RB situation with Brooks
items.opportunity: Lead touches possible vs CHI run D

items.text: Up in pace: NO @ DET. Slow paced slogs: MIA @ LV. Full Week 1 Snaps & Pace from Pat Thorman.
items.implication: Higher volume expected NO-DET; lower MIA-LV
items.opportunity: Snap/route boost in high-pace; caution low-pace
